known_false_positives: A static relative import or conventional NodeNext emitted/source pair may be recorded even when host compiler configuration resolves it differently; it remains an advisory risk, not a rewrite.
known_false_negatives: Unusual import syntax, nonstandard emitted/source mappings, package imports, dynamic imports, aliases, package exports, project references, and compiler-specific resolution are not recorded.
legitimate_similar_shapes: External URLs and prose containing old path-looking text stay unchanged.
Unrelated local TypeScript imports stay unchanged and do not appear as moved-import risks.
